correctness.rationale: The rank-one image-kernel decomposition gives \(N=(q-1)(q+1)^2\) vertices and exact adjacency. The zero-forcing process on one-white-per-type profiles is equivalent to choosing a source type that contains a blue representative and deleting the unique white edge in its row-column union. Such legal deletions are leaf deletions, so a fully reducible profile is acyclic; \(2q+1\) white edges would be a spanning tree with no legal first move. An explicit \(2q\)-edge profile has a complete chronological force sequence, giving the exact formula.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact forcing invariant for the classical simple Artinian matrix family \\(M_2(\mathbb F_q)\\) uniformly over every finite field. The proof identifies a sharp projective image-kernel forest mechanism, so the result is structural rather than a small computation or arbitrary parameter slice.
